stories.headline: AI labs support mandatory breach reporting
stories.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic told Australia's parliament they support mandatory disclosure rules after OpenAI waited three months to report an agent's health-portal breach. The inquiry is also weighing AI copyright and data-center rules.

stories.headline: Mistral claims cybersecurity lead over Chinese AI
stories.summary: Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch says its new model beats Chinese rivals in some cybersecurity tests. He did not name the models or metrics, so the performance claim cannot yet be independently assessed.

stories.headline: Disney challenges FCC's early license review
stories.summary: A federal judge will hear Disney's attempt to block early FCC reviews of eight ABC station licenses. Disney calls the action political retaliation; the case tests broadcasters' First Amendment protections.

stories.headline: Lithuania moves toward allowing nuclear arms
stories.summary: Lithuania's parliament backed the first of two votes needed to remove its constitutional ban on hosting nuclear weapons. Russia called the move escalatory; the measure is not yet final.

stories.headline: Middle East oil exports steady near 14 million bpd
stories.summary: Vitol says roughly 12 million barrels of crude and 2 million barrels of refined products have left the region daily. Its CEO warned a major interruption could sharply destabilize markets; that is a risk scenario, not a forecast.
